description.text: The first cards of the XY Series, released in Italian on 8 November 2013, the same day as in English and the first expansion with Pokémon of the sixth generation. It came as three theme decks built around the Kalos first partner Pokémon Chespin, Fennekin and Froakie, so its 39 cards carry no rarity mark.
